newsitem.title: USA: FCC preparing to grant MCI a valuable license - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: FCC preparing to grant MCI a valuable license - WSJ.

text.p: Federal regulators are preparing to grant a valuable direct-broadcast license to MCI perhaps as early a this week, The Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday.

In doing so, the Journal said, the Federal Communications Commission would dismiss requests by cable television rivals to have the decision delayed until the agency figures out whether British Telecommunications Plc, which plans to acquire MCI, is qualified to hold the setellite license.

Time Warner Inc and other cable competitors had argued that the FCC shouldn't hand MCI the last significant direct-broadcast satellite license in the U.S. until the FCC considers whether British Telecommunications is a qualified foreign owner, the story said.
